content.title: What time does Euphoria season 3 episode 2 drop on HBO Max? Global release time, what to expect, and more
content.text: Zendaya in Euphoria Season 3 (Image via Youtube/@HBO Max) Created by Sam Levinson, Euphoria follows a group of California teenagers and young adults navigating love, trauma, addiction and identity with unflinching honesty. Euphoria season 3 episode 2 titled 'America My Dream' - drops on Sunday April 19, 2026 at 9:00 p.m. ET (6:00 p.m. PT) on HBO with simultaneous streaming on Max. International audiences receive it early Monday, April 20, based on local time zones. There are total 8 episodes in Euphoria season 3. The third season jumps five years ahead - moving characters out of high school into a more brutal adult world filled with crime, debt with fractured relationships and survival struggles. Zendaya returns as Rue Bennett as the anxious and addicted narrator. Sydney Sweeney stars as Cassie Howard whose emotional volatility drives key storylines. Jacob Elordi plays controlling Nate Jacobs while Alexa Demie is Maddy Perez. Hunter Schafer portrays Jules Vaughn while Maude Apatow appears as Lexi Howard and Colman Domingo as Ali. Supporting roles include recurring characters like Faye played by Chloe Cherry and new figures like Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje in the criminal underworld. The series continues exploring mental health with toxic dynamics and societal pressures with its signature raw style and cinematic visuals. Euphoria season 3 episode 2: Global release schedule Region / Time Zone Release Date Release Time United States (ET) April 19, 2026 9:00 PM ET United States (PT) April 19, 2026 6:00 PM PT Canada (ET) April 19, 2026 9:00 PM ET Brazil (BRT) April 19, 2026 10:00 PM BRT United Kingdom (BST) April 20, 2026 2:00 AM BST Germany (CEST) April 20, 2026 3:00 AM CEST UAE (GST) April 20, 2026 5:00 AM GST India (IST) April 20, 2026 6:30 AM IST Singapore (SGT) April 20, 2026 9:00 AM SGT Japan (JST) April 20, 2026 10:00 AM JST Australia (Sydney, AEST) April 20, 2026 11:00 AM AEST What happened in Euphoria season 3 episode 1 and what to expect in episode 2: Episode 1, titled “Ándale,” opens with a significant time jump. Rue works as a drug mule for Laurie to repay a large debt. She swallows fentanyl-laced balloons in Mexico, crosses the U.S. border in a tense sequence involving a stuck car and an encounter with a Christian family then delivers the drugs to a powerful figure named Alamo. Rue impresses Alamo and pitches herself for more work - even after he tests her by shooting an apple off her head with a gun. The tainted drugs add extra danger while Faye assists Rue during the run. Meanwhile, Cassie is engaged to Nate and plans an expensive wedding. She convinces him to let her start an OnlyFans account to fund it. This leads to controversial bold scenes and postures that has sparked buzz online about Sweeney's character arc. Nate now runs his father’s construction business after having him arrested and wants to expand into rest-home franchises. He remains controlling and refuses some of Cassie’s lavish requests. Maddy works as a manager for Dylan Reid, handling administrative tasks while feeling underpaid. Lexi works happily as an assistant to a Hollywood producer and develops a crush on Dylan. Fezco remains in prison serving a long sentence. Episode 2 is expected to deepen these threads. Rue’s involvement with Alamo and Laurie will likely grow more perilous as threats increase and moral lines blur. Cassie’s pursuit of validation through her new adult content and relationship with Nate may face greater strain or public fallout after the premiere’s bold moments. Nate’s power plays could backfire, affecting those around him while Maddy navigates her professional frustrations and shifting social circles. The episode continues the season’s darker tone, mixing crime-thriller elements with character-driven drama and exploring the consequences of past choices in adulthood. Euphoria season 3 airs on HBO and streams at the same time on Max in the United States. In the UK, it is available on Sky Atlantic and NOW. New episodes drop every Sundays till May 31, 2026.
